entry.title: a small guide to citations over rankings
entry.content:
I spent a while getting citations over rankings wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Citations over rankings shows up across seo work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
